summary_en: This Phase II study tests LP-300 given with carboplatin and pemetrexed in people who have never smoked and have advanced lung adenocarcinoma that has returned after treatment with tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). LP-300, carboplatin and pemetrexed are each given by intravenous infusion over 30 minutes every 21 days for 4 to 6 cycles, with the number of cycles set by the investigator. The study measures progression-free survival and overall survival.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II evalúa LP-300 administrado con carboplatino y pemetrexed en personas que nunca han fumado y tienen adenocarcinoma de pulmón avanzado que reapareció después de tratamiento con inhibidores de tirosina cinasa (TKI). LP-300, carboplatino y pemetrexed se administran cada uno por infusión intravenosa durante 30 minutos cada 21 días, por 4 a 6 ciclos, y el investigador determina el número de ciclos. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de progresión y la supervivencia global.
who_for: Inoperable stage III or IV lung adenocarcinoma with a specific actionable genomic alteration.
Never smoker, or fewer than 100 cigarette-equivalents in lifetime (some former smokers may be considered with sponsor approval).
Previously treated with TKIs and had progression, unacceptable toxicity, or cannot tolerate further TKIs.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1, and at least 18 years of age.
Adequate blood counts, liver function and kidney function within 21 days before enrollment.
not_for: Small cell, squamous, large cell, undifferentiated, mesothelioma, or mixed lung cancer types.
Disease that progressed while on chemotherapy or immunotherapy.
Known positive for HIV, hepatitis B surface antigen, or hepatitis C.
Heart events within 6 months, or QTcF above 470 msec.
